description: Enterprise CIS-Hardened Partitioning Layout for RHEL 9

logical_volumes.name: lv_root
logical_volumes.cis_rationale: Root partition for operating system binaries and configuration.

logical_volumes.name: lv_tmp
logical_volumes.cis_rationale: CIS 1.1.2 - 1.1.5: Isolated temporary partition with execution and SUID blocked.

logical_volumes.name: lv_var
logical_volumes.cis_rationale: CIS 1.1.6: Variable data isolation preventing disk exhaustion on root.

logical_volumes.name: lv_log
logical_volumes.cis_rationale: CIS 1.1.7 - 1.1.9: Isolated logging partition preventing log injection exploits.

logical_volumes.name: lv_audit
logical_volumes.cis_rationale: CIS 1.1.10 - 1.1.12: Dedicated auditd log storage to avoid audit shutdown on disk full.

logical_volumes.name: lv_home
logical_volumes.cis_rationale: CIS 1.1.13 - 1.1.15: Dedicated user home directories with SUID escalation blocked.

swap.name: lv_swap
swap.cis_rationale: Swap space allocation for memory overflow protection.
